data.name: TARAE: The Unbound
data.detailed_description:
Sever Fate. 

TARAE: The Unbound is a top-down action RPG set in an Eastern dark fantasy.

Mercilessly carve your way through swarms of enemies, master the patterns of powerful foes, and overcome every challenge standing in your way.

  • Cut Down the Horde Use a wide arsenal of skills and chained attacks to tear through the battlefield. Experience a combat system that hits as hard as it looks.

  • Boss Battles Built to Be Mastered Learn the patterns and tricks of menacing boss monsters. Seize your moment to dodge, counter, and carve your path to glory.

  • Relentless Action, Merciless Impact Every hit lands with satisfying force, making each fight exhilarating to tear through a mass of enemies.

  • Combat Shaped by Your Decisions Combine class skills, traits, support skills, and gear into a build and playstyle that's all your own.

  • Six Seekers, One Intertwined Tale Travel with the six Seekers, each carrying their own karma and purpose. Through countless trials, seek true understanding to become true allies.

  • Journey Across Taegwido, at the Shattered Boundaries of the Six Realms Step into a world that reimagines Eastern myth, folklore, and traditional aesthetics, where beauty and mystery are entwined with darkness and brutality.

Each battle and every choice shapes the path to restoring order to the Six Realms.

Taegwido, an island born upon the collapsed Six Realms

"The Sources that can restore the cycle of reincarnation lie scattered across Taegwido."

The outcast Agasa shattered the boundaries to break the wheel of reincarnation. From these fractured lands, the island of Taegwido was born. Explore Taegwido and the rifts to seek the Sources and restore the Six Realms.

Six seekers, six afflictions

"Six Seekers, six different paths. Their fates begin to entwine in Taegwido."

Become one of the six Seekers and set out to recover the Sources scattered across Taegwido. The other Seekers, each driven by their own purpose, will join you as allies along the way. As you face countless trials together, you will come to understand and rely on one another.

As the story unfolds, their pasts, wounds, and the reasons for entering Taegwido will gradually come to light. Walk the path to restore the Six Realms and witness a tale of souls burdened by different karma becoming true companions.

Foes Awakened from Legend

Creatures from Eastern myth and folklore emerge as powerful bosses, their lore and presence shaping the very grounds on which you face them.

Read each boss and ever-shifting battlefield, then choose your moment to dodge and counter. Every foe demands a different answer.

Darkness Beneath the Beauty

Tranquil temples and fallen citadels. War-scarred lands and streets tangled with fiendish phantoms. Discover a world that blends Eastern aesthetics with mythic imagination. Beautiful as it may be, beneath the surface lurk twisted beings and ancient tragedy.

Discover rich landscapes with distinct character and stories all their own. Experience TARAE's take on Eastern dark fantasy, where beauty and cruelty coexist.

Every Choice Opens a New Path

TARAE reimagines classes rooted in Eastern tradition through fast, distinctive combat. Wield blades and firearms, master martial and mystic arts, or command the power of spirits. Each class fights with its own combat resource and skill system.

Set the core of your build with traits, then open new branches with support skills and unique gear. The balance and conflict of the Five Elements, the harmony of Yin and Yang, karma and the cycle of reincarnation all shape your leveling, equipment, and combat style. Even within a single class, different choices lead to entirely different builds.

"The wheel of reincarnation is about to turn. Better start building up some karma now."

Wishlist and follow TARAE now to be the first to hear what comes next.
